title: Merrow takes the lead after service week
author: Ines Marchetti
summary: Merrow logged 1,140 service hours in a week and moved to the top of the House Cup table.
body:
Service week sent every house out into Tarrenhurst: the food pantry, the river cleanup and reading at the public library.

Merrow's 110 points came mostly from the river cleanup, where its Grade 10 students pulled forty bags of litter from the Merrow stream.
pull: Forty bags out of our own stream. That felt like the right way to earn it.

title: What the stream survey found this fall
author: Hamish Okonkwo
summary: Field Biology counted 14 species of macroinvertebrates in the Merrow, the highest count since the survey began.
body:
Every Tuesday this fall, Field Biology walked down to the stream with nets and trays.

Fourteen species, including two kinds of stonefly, suggest the water is cleaner than it was five years ago.
pull: Stoneflies don't lie. If they are there, the water is good.

title: Our Town: rehearsal notes from week four
author: Tomasz Brandt
summary: Thirty students, one ladder and a lot of chairs: the fall play opens November 19.
body:
Thornton Wilder asked for almost no set. We took him at his word.

The cast has been rehearsing in the round, so the audience will sit on the stage.
pull: We took the set away and the play got bigger.

title: Cross-country finishes second at the league meet
author: Nadia Corrigan
summary: Three runners finished in the top ten on a muddy course.
body: The team trained on Calder Fell all season, which helped on a wet and hilly course.
pull: The hill is our home course. Mud is just part of it.

title: Grade 3 harvest lunch
author: Margit Ellery
summary: The walled garden fed the Lower School: squash soup, salad and apple crisp.
body: Grade 3 planted in April and harvested in September. The kitchen team helped cook.
pull: I grew this carrot. It's the best carrot.

title: Class of 1976 returns for its 50th
author: Ines Marchetti
summary: Forty-one alumni came back, toured the archive and sat in on a Harkness class.
body: The archive pulled out the 1976 yearbook and the old house cup ledger.
pull: The tables are the same. The arguments are better.
